contract.browserEvidence: Actual local application: dorm allocation/questionnaire records/creation, unified filter toolbar, desktop and mobile in both themes; isolated fixture workflow and access checks.

experienceRevision.scope: Presentation refinements plus authorized bookmark search/type query parameters, sharing existing ownership and content visibility filters. Earlier card deletion capability remains. No deployment.

baseline.trackingRef: origin/main matched the local HEAD; not fetched during this review
baseline.previewScope: Existing real React components with isolated UI fixture data and router substitutes; no backend submission verification.

sourceHashComparison.scope: Online src, public, package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml and vite.config.ts against the initial local working tree

preserve: Semantic color roles, selective Chrome/Floating versus opaque Reading responsibilities and fallback mechanisms; canvas, floating fill, highlights, shadows and modal continuity recalibrated this revision
Full-width PageLayout, container-based detail/settings columns and local reading measures
Feedback rows, homepage section order, five-item limits, pin rules and post/activity ordering
Activity detail asideFirstOnMobile, current booking result summary and real status semantics
Fixed media ratios, object-contain, local upload/crop/remove and legacy image handling
Existing theme, focus/dialog, touch targets, fallbacks, permissions and asynchronous booking contract

materialCalibration.spec: ui-layout.md#17-背景与毛玻璃专项复核
materialCalibration.background: Recalibrate gradient extent, position, lightness/chroma and alpha over a neutral purple-gray base; do not amplify large purple fields merely to emphasize glass
materialCalibration.chrome: Evaluate real tint and edge separation at rest, actual content blur during scroll, and text clarity; backdrop-filter presence alone is not acceptance
materialCalibration.floating: Review fill plus scrim plus opaque inner regions as a composite; retain solid fields and reading areas without automatically adding a full inner card
materialCalibration.modalSwitch: Only background backdrop sampling is disabled while a dialog is open; navigation fill is unchanged.
comparison: Gradient on/off with other parameters fixed
Blur on/off with identical canvas and fill; compare full solid fallback separately
Static/scrolled guest and workspace pages in both themes
Modal, command menu and drawer open/close in desktop and mobile representative sizes
materialCalibration.evidenceLimit: Representative actual-page screenshots and conservative browser contrast checks; physical devices, other browsers and production field metrics remain unverified.
materialCalibration.evidence: local validation report (not tracked)#材质与性能
materialCalibration.readingSurfaces: No decorative outer frame; light canvas/card L=97/99, dark L=13/15.5. Subtle separators, no header bands or stacked toolbar panels. Inputs and focus retain functional boundaries.

welcome.presentation: Independent static img in the content grid, object-fit:contain, original colors and complete silhouette; never a text-bearing background composite
welcome.guestDesktopGrid: minmax(0,1fr) auto; character at upper right aligned with title top; width clamp(140px,18vw,220px)

guestMobileContentStartTarget.condition: Default font size; allow natural growth with text zoom

welcome.fallback: Intrinsic size remains reserved; onError and a post-hydration complete/naturalWidth check hide failed images while copy and CTA remain usable.
welcome.guestMobileLayout: Title left, character right on the same top row; description and CTA span both columns below; no centered or below-CTA mascot
welcome.authenticatedHeaderAction: none; feedback entry is the third shortcut

hierarchy: search and labeled conditions in coeer-filter-toolbar
filters.longGroupPresentation: Labeled native Select for long groups and narrow containers; view navigation remains separate pressed buttons.
filters.interaction: Native selection applies the existing single condition immediately. Clear keeps the view; scoped navigation merges the latest URL state and resets page one.
filters.label: 600 weight foreground label; divider on inline desktop groups; separate label above native select on narrow screens
filters.summary: Removed from all pages; active values remain in controls. Clear stays in the toolbar at a stable size and is disabled when no filters are active.
filters.search: Every list search uses FilterPanel; feedback admin, booking admin and allowlist migrated. Existing live/submitted search semantics retained.

sectionSpacing.internalScope: Shared adjacent-sibling rule adds 24px between nested scope tabs and the toolbar
sectionSpacing.externalScope: Page layout provides 24px; no additional toolbar margin
sectionSpacing.density: Card internals and form fields retain their own spacing

modulePolicies.community: Continuous reading and restrained metadata; keep discovery/activity grids where useful; local 76ch reading measure, original feed/pin/reply rules
modulePolicies.commerceAndAchievements: Container grids, aligned actions, real cost/stock/progress; product 16:9, card 3:4, achievement 1:1; original colors and contain
modulePolicies.servicesAndAdministration: Feedback uses the group-page shell, independent status cards and pagination. Space views place the shared two-link navigation below each page title; no admin link in that navigation. Other opaque tables/forms and original workflows remain.

rules: Use readable group/search labels, Chinese roles and point-source names; keep technical identifiers only where administrators need them
Distinguish empty data, filtered-out results, failed requests, unknown balance and insufficient points
Distinguish service unavailable, permission not yet loaded and known permission denial
Preserve user-authored content and supported search capabilities; never replace unknown statistics with zero

implementationRuntime.application: complete TanStack SSR application; real routes, loaders and sessions
implementationRuntime.booking: mock only; official connector writes disabled
implementationRuntime.fonts: application system fallback; Google font requests blocked consistently
implementationRuntime.matrixScope: Revision 7: 8 actual pages at 1440/390 in light/dark, stable toolbar height, combined search, cycle navigation, real create/compute/edit/confirm workflow in an isolated temporary cycle, and admin guards. Earlier revisions retain broader route coverage.

managementEditor.layout: list / create-or-edit tabs, same as group views
managementEditor.mounting: both panels stay mounted; hidden inactive panel
managementEditor.deleteCard: admin-only; transaction locks definition; refuse owned cards; confirm and refresh current page

bookmarks.matching: server-side case-insensitive literal substring; visibility and ownership before pagination/count
bookmarks.outOfRange: redirect to current last page retaining filters
bookmarks.presentation: header, FilterPanel, separate PostCard bookmark summaries, pagination; group origin inside the card

dormAdministration.navigation: Shared group-style underline tabs; cycleId retained across links and reload
dormAdministration.creation: Creates an existing dorm cycle; fixed questionnaire content retained
dormAdministration.layout: Full-width workspace, compact metrics and room cards; independent paginated questionnaire records; labeled creation form with adjacent explanation
dormAdministration.permissions: Existing admin route and server guards retained
dormAdministration.workflow: Existing compute/update/confirm APIs; operation feedback and refresh; no backend logic changes

narrative.northStar: 清晰、全宽的学院社区玻璃工作区
narrative.overview:
中性紫灰画布与内容表面保持相近明度，普通卡片不画外框、不加阴影，使用留白和细分隔线组织层级。导航与浮层保留受控毛玻璃，字段、正文与图片清晰。

欢迎页工小成位于右上，与标题顶部齐平；手机采用标题与角色同排，说明和操作在下一行。全宽工作区、模块结构和业务契约沿用。当前视觉修订为4，见 local validation report (not tracked)。
keyCharacteristics: 低饱和紫灰画布与最多两处静态渐变。
导航与浮层受控玻璃，正文实底。
全宽工作区，容器响应式分栏与局部阅读行宽。
共享深浅主题、键盘与触屏契约。
对比度、性能预算和效果回退可验收。

rules.name: The Fluid Workspace Rule
rules.body: 工作区占满侧栏之外的可用宽度，仅保留统一页边距；局部正文与字段可限宽，页面容器不设固定最大宽度。

rules.name: The Selective Glass Rule
rules.body: Chrome 仅用于导航与顶栏，Floating 仅用于覆盖层；正文 Card、表单和表格不透明、无 blur。

rules.name: The Readable Surface Rule
rules.body: 以最终合成背景验收文字 4.5:1 与必要非文本 3:1；高光不替代控件边界或焦点。

rules.name: The Semantic Color Rule
rules.body: 操作与进行中用 primary；成功、待处理、错误有独立实底状态色、文字和图形，保持真实业务语义。

rules.name: The Progressive Enhancement Rule
rules.body: 先交付可用实底，再检测背景模糊支持；用户偏好或性能超预算时回退，任务功能保持可用。

dos: 使用统一语义令牌与现有组件。
以 Reading 保持长文、表单和数据表清晰。
全宽对齐页面标题、操作、导航与主体。
验证两主题、触屏、键盘及无 blur 路径。
按真实服务状态呈现加载、空内容和错误。
donts: 不把所有 Card 或列表项变成玻璃。
不增加整页固定最大宽度或漂浮外壳留白。
不嵌套 blur、动画 blur 或添加紫色光晕。
不用颜色单独表达状态，不移除可见焦点。
不以设计样例伪造正式页面的统计与内容。
